name: Sylvia Goldschmidt
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in White Plains, New York
side_practice_areas: Family Law, Alternative Dispute Resolution, International
about: Sylvia Goldschmidt is a partner at Abrams Fensterman, LLP, in White Plains, New York, where she brings nearly four decades of experience guiding clients through complex matrimonial and family law matters. A lifelong advocate for families, she combines deep legal experience with a thoughtful, client-centered approach, helping individuals navigate sensitive issues with clarity and confidence.

Ms. Goldschmidt earned her undergraduate degree, magna cum laude, from the State University of New York at Buffalo, received her J.D. from Brooklyn Law School and completed an LL.M. in Taxation at New York University School of Law. This strong academic foundation has supported her extensive practice in family law, where she regularly handles high-stakes divorce proceedings, complex property divisions, child custody and support disputes, as well as the drafting and negotiation of separation agreements, prenuptial agreements, and settlement agreements.

Ms. Goldschmidt’s practice also extends to international family law, including cross-border custody disputes, enforcement of foreign divorce decrees and international prenuptial agreements. Trained in collaborative law and mediation, she seeks solutions that reflect both the legal and personal needs of her clients. She primarily serves clients in Westchester and Rockland counties, often addressing cases with intricate financial or custody issues that require sophisticated legal strategy.

Recognized as a leader in her field, Ms. Goldschmidt holds an AV Preeminent* peer-review rating through Martindale-Hubbell and has been listed in The Best Lawyers in America continuously since 1999, earning the distinction of Lawyer of the Year in 2014 and 2017.

A respected voice in the legal community, Ms. Goldschmidt has served as president of both the U.S. Chapter of the International Academy of Family Lawyers and the New York Chapter of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers. She has held leadership positions within the New York State Bar Association, the Westchester Women’s Bar Association, the Westchester County Bar Association and the Association of Family and Conciliation Courts. She has also contributed to national initiatives, including the Honoring Families Initiative through the Institute for the Advancement of the American Legal System.

In addition to her practice, Ms. Goldschmidt is deeply committed to legal education. She has been a faculty member of the American Academy of Matrimonial Law Institute for Associates for over 15 years, lectured at conferences on advanced child custody matters and trained professionals through programs, including the AICPA Expert Witness Workshops and various bar association events. With her unmatched experience, leadership and dedication to both clients and the profession, she continues to be a guiding force in family law, helping families achieve resolutions that protect their interests and well-being.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
